translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Libationer of the Minister of Education, then served as left army chief clerk to Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan and as Magistrate of Qiantang, again achieving administrative merit.

sentences.zh: 復為司徒主簿。

translations.literal: He again served as Chief Clerk to the Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as chief clerk to the Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 起為武康令，固辭不免，到縣百許日，稱疾去官。

translations.literal: He was recalled to serve as Magistrate of Wukang. He firmly declined but could not avoid it. After reaching the county for about a hundred days, he claimed illness and resigned his post.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as Magistrate of Wukang. He firmly declined but could not avoid it. After reaching the county for about a hundred days, he claimed illness and resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 服闋，除司徒左西掾，州治中從事史。

translations.literal: When his mourning ended, he was appointed Left Western Aide of the Minister of Education and Registrar and Attendant Clerk of the province.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended, he was appointed left western aide of the Minister of Education and registrar and attendant clerk of the province.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十二年，東諸郡大水，民人饑饉，吳義興及吳郡之錢唐，升米三百。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yuanjia the eastern commanderies suffered great floods. The people were starving. In Yixing of Wu and Qiantang in Wu Commandery, a sheng of rice cost three hundred cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Yuanjia the eastern commanderies suffered great floods. The people were starving. In Yixing of Wu and Qiantang in Wu Commandery, a sheng of rice cost three hundred cash.

sentences.zh: 以演之及尚書祠部郎江邃並兼散騎常侍，巡行拯恤，許以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Yanzhi and Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Jiang Sui were both additionally made Regular Attendants of the Dispersed Cavalry to tour the region and provide relief, with permission to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yanzhi and Gentleman of the Ministry of Rites Jiang Sui were both additionally made Regular Attendants of the Dispersed Cavalry to tour the region and provide relief, with permission to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 演之乃開倉廩以賑饑民，民有生子者，口賜米一斗，刑獄有疑枉，悉制遣之，百姓蒙賴。

translations.literal: Yanzhi then opened the granaries to relieve the starving people. For each person who gave birth he granted one dou of rice per mouth. Where criminal cases held doubtful wrongs, he ordered them all released. The common people relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yanzhi then opened the granaries to relieve the starving people. For each person who gave birth he granted one dou of rice per mouth. Where criminal cases held doubtful wrongs, he ordered them all released. The common people relied on him.

sentences.zh: 轉別駕從事史，領本郡中正，深為義康所待，故在府州前後十餘年。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Assistant Director and Attendant Clerk, and headed the provincial rectifier of his native commandery. He was deeply favored by Yikang, and so remained at the headquarters and province for more than ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to assistant director and attendant clerk, and headed the provincial rectifier of his native commandery. He was deeply favored by Liu Yikang, and so remained at headquarters and province for more than ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 後劉湛、劉斌等結黨，欲排廢尚書僕射殷景仁，演之雅仗正義，與湛等不同，湛因此讒之於義康。

translations.literal: Later Liu Zhan, Liu Bin, and others formed a faction wishing to drive out and disgrace Vice Director Yin Jingren. Yanzhi by nature relied on righteousness and differed from Zhan and the others. Zhan therefore slandered him before Yikang.
translations.idiomatic: Later Liu Zhan, Liu Bin, and others formed a faction wishing to drive out and disgrace Vice Director Yin Jingren. Shen Yanzhi by nature relied on righteousness and differed from Zhan and the others. Zhan therefore slandered him before Liu Yikang.

sentences.zh: 嘗因論事不合旨，義康變色曰：「自今而後，我不復相信！

translations.literal: Once, because his discussion of affairs did not accord with Yikang's intent, Yikang changed color and said, "From this day forward I will no longer trust you!
translations.idiomatic: Once, because his discussion of affairs did not accord with Liu Yikang's intent, Yikang changed color and said, "From this day forward I will no longer trust you!

sentences.zh: 」演之與景仁素善，盡心於朝庭，太祖甚嘉之，以為尚書吏部郎。

translations.literal: " Yanzhi and Jingren had long been on good terms. He devoted himself wholeheartedly to the court. Taizu greatly praised him and appointed him Director of Personnel in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: " Shen Yanzhi and Yin Jingren had long been on good terms. He devoted himself wholeheartedly to the court. Emperor Taizu greatly praised him and appointed him Director of Personnel in the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十七年，義康出籓，誅湛等，以演之為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Yikang went out to his princely fief. Zhan and the others were executed, and Yanzhi was made General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Liu Yikang went out to his princely fief. Zhan and the others were executed, and Shen Yanzhi was made General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 景仁尋卒，乃以後軍長史范曄為左衛將軍，與演之對掌禁旅，同參機密。

translations.literal: Jingren soon died. Fan Ye, Chief Administrator of the Rear Army, was then made General of the Left Guard to share command of the palace guard with Yanzhi and jointly participate in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jingren soon died. Fan Ye, chief administrator of the rear army, was then made General of the Left Guard to share command of the palace guard with Shen Yanzhi and jointly participate in confidential affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遷侍中，右衛將軍如故。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Gentleman Attendant, while remaining General of the Right Guard as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Gentleman Attendant, while remaining General of the Right Guard as before.

sentences.zh: 太祖謂之曰：「侍中領衛，望實優顯，此蓋宰相便坐，卿其勉之。

translations.literal: Taizu said to him, "Gentleman Attendant commanding the guard—your reputation and substance are eminent and distinguished. This is essentially the chief minister's seat of convenience. You should exert yourself.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu said to him, "Gentleman Attendant commanding the guard—your reputation and substance are eminent and distinguished. This is essentially the chief minister's seat of convenience. You should exert yourself.

sentences.zh: 」上欲伐林邑，朝臣不同，唯廣州刺史陸徽與演之贊成上意。

translations.literal: " The emperor wished to campaign against Linyi. The court ministers were not of one mind. Only Inspector of Guangzhou Lu Hui and Yanzhi supported the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor wished to campaign against Linyi. The court ministers were not of one mind. Only Inspector of Guangzhou Lu Hui and Shen Yanzhi supported the emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 及平，賜群臣黃金、生口、銅器等物，演之所得偏多。

translations.literal: When it was pacified, the ministers were granted gold, captives, bronze vessels, and other goods. Yanzhi received a comparatively larger share.
translations.idiomatic: When it was pacified, the ministers were granted gold, captives, bronze vessels, and other goods. Shen Yanzhi received a comparatively larger share.

sentences.zh: 上謂之曰：「廟堂之謀，卿參其力，平此遠夷，未足多建茅土。

translations.literal: The emperor said to him, "In the planning within the temple hall you contributed your strength. Pacifying this distant barbarian land is not enough to warrant extensive enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to him, "In the planning within the temple hall you contributed your strength. Pacifying this distant barbarian land is not enough to warrant extensive enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 廓清京都，鳴鸞東岱，不憂河山不開也。

translations.literal: When the capital is cleared and purified and the imperial carriage sounds its bells at Mount Dai in the east, you need not worry that the rivers and mountains will not be opened.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital is cleared and purified and the imperial carriage sounds its bells at Mount Dai in the east, you need not worry that the rivers and mountains will not be opened.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年，詔曰：「總司戎政，翼贊東朝，惟允之舉，匪賢莫授。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-first year an edict said, "To oversee military affairs overall and assist the Eastern Palace—such trustworthy appointments must be given only to the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-first year an edict said, "To oversee military affairs overall and assist the Eastern Palace—such trustworthy appointments must be given only to the worthy.

sentences.zh: 侍中領右衛將軍演之，清業貞審，器思沈濟。

translations.literal: Gentleman Attendant and General of the Right Guard Yanzhi has a pure career, integrity, and carefulness, with depth of thought and steady resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman Attendant and General of the Right Guard Shen Yanzhi has a pure career, integrity, and carefulness, with depth of thought and steady resolve.

sentences.zh: 右衛將軍曄，才應通敏，理懷清要。

translations.literal: General of the Right Guard Ye has talent that responds with quick intelligence and principles held with clarity and refinement.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Right Guard Fan Ye has talent that responds with quick intelligence and principles held with clarity and refinement.

sentences.zh: 並美彰出內，誠亮在公，能克懋厥猷，樹績所蒞。

translations.literal: Both have beauty displayed within and without, sincerity and brightness in public service, and the ability to exert themselves in their plans and establish achievements in the posts they oversee.
translations.idiomatic: Both have beauty displayed within and without, sincerity and brightness in public service, and the ability to exert themselves in their plans and establish achievements in the posts they oversee.

sentences.zh: 演之可中領軍，曄可太子詹事。

translations.literal: Yanzhi may become Central Army Commander; Ye may become Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yanzhi may become Central Army Commander; Fan Ye may become Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 」曄懷逆謀，演之覺其有異，言之太祖，曄尋事發伏誅。

translations.literal: " Ye harbored treasonous designs. Yanzhi noticed that something was amiss and reported it to Taizu. Ye soon had his plot exposed and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Fan Ye harbored treasonous designs. Shen Yanzhi noticed that something was amiss and reported it to Emperor Taizu. Ye soon had his plot exposed and was executed.

sentences.zh: 遷領國子祭酒，本州大中正，轉吏部尚書，領太子右衛率。

translations.literal: He was transferred to head the Imperial Academy, became Grand Rectifier of his native province, was then transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, and concurrently served as Commander of the Crown Prince's Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to head the Imperial Academy, became grand rectifier of his native province, was then transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, and concurrently served as Commander of the Crown Prince's Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 雖未為宰相，任寄不異也。

translations.literal: Although he had not become chief minister, the trust placed in him was no different.
translations.idiomatic: Although he had not become chief minister, the trust placed in him was no different.

sentences.zh: 素有心氣，疾病歷年，上使臥疾治事。

translations.literal: He had long suffered from heart and qi ailments. His illness lasted for years, and the emperor had him conduct affairs while lying ill.
translations.idiomatic: He had long suffered from heart and qi ailments. His illness lasted for years, and the emperor had him conduct affairs while lying ill.

sentences.zh: 性好舉才，申濟屈滯，而謙約自持，上賜女伎，不受。

translations.literal: By nature he loved to recommend talent and bring relief to those blocked and stagnant. Yet he maintained himself with humility and restraint. The emperor granted him female performers, but he did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he loved to recommend talent and bring relief to those blocked and stagnant. Yet he maintained himself with humility and restraint. The emperor granted him female performers, but he did not accept them.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，車駕拜京陵，演之以疾不從。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the imperial carriage went to pay respects at the capital tombs. Yanzhi did not follow because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the imperial carriage went to pay respects at the capital tombs. Shen Yanzhi did not follow because of illness.

sentences.zh: 上還宮，召見，自勉到坐，出至尚書下省，暴卒，時年五十三。

translations.literal: When the emperor returned to the palace he summoned Yanzhi for an audience. Yanzhi exerted himself to reach his seat. After leaving and arriving at the lower office of the Masters of Writing, he died suddenly. He was then fifty-three years old.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor returned to the palace he summoned Shen Yanzhi for an audience. Yanzhi exerted himself to reach his seat. After leaving and arriving at the lower office of the Masters of Writing, he died suddenly. He was then fifty-three years old.

sentences.zh: 太祖痛惜之，追贈散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫，諡曰貞侯。

translations.literal: Taizu grieved deeply for him. Posthumously he was granted Regular Attendant of the Dispersed Cavalry and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Cord. His posthumous title was Marquis Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu grieved deeply for him. Posthumously he was granted Regular Attendant of the Dispersed Cavalry and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Cord. His posthumous title was Marquis Zhen.

sentences.zh: 演之昔與同使江邃字玄遠，濟陽考城人。

translations.literal: Yanzhi's former fellow envoy Jiang Sui, courtesy name Xuan Yuan, was a native of Kaocheng in Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yanzhi's former fellow envoy Jiang Sui, whose courtesy name was Xuan Yuan, came from Kaocheng in Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 頗有文義。

translations.literal: He possessed considerable literary learning.
translations.idiomatic: He possessed considerable literary learning.

sentences.zh: 官至司徒記室參軍，撰《文釋》，傳於世。

translations.literal: He rose to Recording Secretary Adjutant of the Minister of Education and compiled Literary Explanations, which was transmitted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to the post of recording secretary adjutant of the Minister of Education and compiled Literary Explanations, which was transmitted in the world.

sentences.zh: 演之子睦，至黃門郎，通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Yanzhi's son Mu rose to Gentleman at the Yellow Gate and Regular Attendant of the Dispersed Cavalry on Direct Duty.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Yanzhi's son Shen Mu rose to Gentleman at the Yellow Gate and Regular Attendant of the Dispersed Cavalry on Direct Duty.

sentences.zh: 世祖大明初，坐要引上左右俞欣之訪評殿省內事，又與弟西陽王文學勃忿鬩不睦，坐徙始興郡，勃免官禁錮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daming under Emperor Shizu, Mu was punished for summoning the emperor's attendant Yu Xinzhi to inquire into and comment on affairs within the palace offices. He also quarreled bitterly with his younger brother Bo, Literary Instructor to Prince of Xiyang Wang. On these charges he was banished to Shixing Commandery, and Bo was dismissed from office and placed under restriction.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daming under Emperor Shizu, Shen Mu was punished for summoning the emperor's attendant Yu Xinzhi to inquire into and comment on affairs within the palace offices. He also quarreled bitterly with his younger brother Shen Bo, literary instructor to Prince of Xiyang Wang. On these charges he was banished to Shixing Commandery, and Bo was dismissed from office and placed under restriction.

sentences.zh: 勃弟統，大明中為著作佐郎。

translations.literal: Bo's younger brother Tong, during the Daming era, served as Assistant Gentleman Author.
translations.idiomatic: Bo's younger brother Shen Tong, during the Daming era, served as Assistant Gentleman Author.

sentences.zh: 先是，五省官所給幹僮，不得雜役，太祖世，坐以免官者，前後百人。

translations.literal: Earlier, the official attendants granted to officials of the five secretariats were not to be used for miscellaneous labor. During Taizu's reign, those punished by dismissal from office for this numbered a hundred people before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the official attendants granted to officials of the five secretariats were not to be used for miscellaneous labor. During Emperor Taizu's reign, those punished by dismissal from office for this numbered a hundred people before and after.

sentences.zh: 統輕役過差，有司奏免。

translations.literal: Tong used attendants for light labor beyond proper limits. The relevant offices memorialized for his dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Tong used attendants for light labor beyond proper limits. The relevant offices memorialized for his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 世祖詔曰：「自頃幹僮，多不祗給，主可量聽行杖。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu issued an edict, saying, "Recently official attendants have often failed to serve properly. Their masters may, as appropriate, be permitted to apply the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu issued an edict, saying, "Recently official attendants have often failed to serve properly. Their masters may, as appropriate, be permitted to apply the staff.

sentences.zh: 」得行幹杖，自此始也。

translations.literal: " The permission to apply the staff to official attendants began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: " The permission to apply the staff to official attendants began from this point.

sentences.zh: 演之兄融之子暢之，襲寧新縣男。

translations.literal: Changzhi, son of Yanzhi's older brother Rongzhi, inherited the barony of Ningxin County.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhi, son of Shen Yanzhi's older brother Shen Rongzhi, inherited the barony of Ningxin County.

sentences.zh: 大明中，為海陵王休茂北中郎諮議參軍，為休茂所殺，追贈黃門郎。

translations.literal: During the Daming era he served as Advisory Adjutant to the Northern Palace Guard of Prince of Hailing Xiumao and was killed by Xiumao. Posthumously he was granted Gentleman at the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: During the Daming era he served as advisory adjutant to the northern palace guard of Prince of Hailing Liu Xiumao and was killed by Xiumao. Posthumously he was granted Gentleman at the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 子曄嗣，齊受禪，國除。

translations.literal: His son Ye succeeded. When Qi received the abdication, the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ye succeeded. When Qi received the abdication, the fief was abolished.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：元嘉初，誅滅宰相，蓋王華、孔甯子之力也。

translations.literal: The historian says: At the beginning of Yuanjia, the execution and destruction of the chief ministers was largely due to the efforts of Wang Hua and Kong Ningzi.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: At the beginning of Yuanjia, the execution and destruction of the chief ministers was largely due to the efforts of Wang Hua and Kong Ningzi.

sentences.zh: 彼群公義雖往結，恩實今疏，而任即曩權，意非昔主，居上六之窮爻，當來寵之要轍，顛覆所基，非待他釁，況於廢殺之重，其隙易乘乎！

translations.literal: Those lords in righteousness had ties from the past, but in favor they were in truth now estranged. Their posts were the same as former power, yet their intent was not that of the former lord. Occupying the exhausted line of the upper sixth, they stood at the crucial track of coming favor. The foundation of their overthrow did not wait for another pretext—how much more so when the weight of deposition and killing made the gap easy to exploit!
translations.idiomatic: Those lords in righteousness had ties from the past, but in favor they were in truth now estranged. Their posts were the same as former power, yet their intent was not that of the former lord. Occupying the exhausted line of the upper sixth, they stood at the crucial track of coming favor. The foundation of their overthrow did not wait for another pretext—how much more so when the weight of deposition and killing made the gap easy to exploit!

sentences.zh: 夫殺人而取其璧，不知在己興累；

translations.literal: To kill a man and take his jade disk is not to know that one thereby raises trouble for oneself.
translations.idiomatic: To kill a man and take his jade disk is not to know that one thereby raises trouble for oneself.

sentences.zh: 傾物而移其寵，不忌自我難持。

translations.literal: To overturn others and transfer their favor is not to fear that one will find it hard to sustain oneself.
translations.idiomatic: To overturn others and transfer their favor is not to fear that one will find it hard to sustain oneself.

sentences.zh: 若二子永年，亦未知來禍所止也。

translations.literal: Had those two men lived out their full years, one still would not have known where later calamity would stop.
translations.idiomatic: Had those two men lived out their full years, one still would not have known where later calamity would stop.

sentences.zh: 有能戒彼而悟此，則所望於來哲。

translations.literal: If there are those who can take warning from them and understand this, that is what is hoped for from sages to come.
translations.idiomatic: If there are those who can take warning from them and understand this, that is what is hoped for from sages to come.
